annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministerio de Tecnologías de la Información y las Comunicaciones (MinTIC), Colombia
key_provisions_or_claims: END 2023-2026 has eight axes, including artificial intelligence, with 100 actions and 13 indicators.
Plans a public policy roadmap for responsible development and adoption of AI.
Will define a governance model to coordinate and monitor digital transformation initiatives.
Targets include raising internet accesses from 38 to over 71 million and training 797,000 people in digital skills.
Progress to be tracked via a web portal and dashboard.
annotation.summary_en: MinTIC press release announcing the launch of Colombia's National Digital Strategy 2023-2026, built on data, AI and innovation. It outlines eight axes, 100 actions, connectivity and skills targets, and a planned roadmap for responsible AI adoption and a governance model. No robotics content.
annotation.title_clean: Inteligencia Artificial, innovación y datos, las apuestas para volver a Colombia una PotencIA Digital
annotation.title_en: Artificial Intelligence, innovation and data: the bets to make Colombia a Digital "PotencIA"
